notes.title: Upcoming: Nasal Nomad: Sniffer's Delight
notes.notes:
[h1]Nasal Nomad: Sniffer's Delight[/h1]
Game studio Tiny Nomads are working on their upcoming game [b]Nasal Nomad: Sniffer's Delight[/b],  a game where you play as Sniffer, a runny nose with snotty legs & toes!

Master nose-related abilities, befriend quirky characters, and find your way out of the smelly sewers where every breath counts!

As Wognum Studios and Tiny Nomads overlap, we are collaborating on this announcement.

[h2][b]Go show some love, support and wishlist the game![/b]
[/h2]
[previewyoutube=McmBkjgigCk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: NEW GAME: Pirates & Pirater!
notes.notes:
[i]Pirates & Pirater[/i] is an First-Person Action-Adventure where pirates have replaced their metal arsenal with fruit, meat & vegetables! [b]Cook [/b]up your armory, [b]eat [/b]your fill of tasty weaponry & [b]fight [/b]in the culinary war!

[i]Pirates & Pirater[/i] will mark the next time in [b]Wognum Studios'[/b] journey as its' second official release and will be arriving to Steam [b]this year[/b]!

[b]Wishlist[/b] [i]Pirates & Pirater[/i] and stay tuned for [b]updates and playtests[/b]!

Thank you for your support of Bengbo and I am looking forward to sharing what comes!

[b]Steam Page Link:[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2727960/Pirates__Pirater/]Pirates & Pirater[/url]
